issues: 纯色浅灰平底，曲线是一律 1.2px 的纯黑线，画面生硬单薄
来源节点是写着 S1–S4 的白圆，像调试占位；四个节点驻留位左右错开（40 步扫描精度不足），排不成一列
数据包是 7px 空心蓝圈，没有速度感，看起来像噪点
徽标是白底黑星，和来源节点同一视觉权重，汇聚点不突出；吞并瞬间只有一次缩放
结尾徽标停在画面右侧 3/4 处，字幕左偏且逐词加深一直拖到最后一帧，尾帧构图失衡、没有落定
changes: 背景换成柔光浅底（主光偏右上 + 极淡靛蓝余光 + 暗角 + 颗粒）；曲线改为 0.9px 圆头、从浅灰到近黑的渐变描边，读出流向
节点改为受光白瓷圆片（渐变 + 发丝线 + 内高光 + 随尺寸变化的两层软阴影）+ 灰阶线性图标（数据库/云/表格/API），入场改为约 8% 过冲弹出；f0 直接按直线段长标定 96/len，四节点严格对齐
数据包改为实心强调色渐变点 + 9 点彗尾（沿路径向后采样，透明度与半径递减），周期与相位偏移不变
徽标改为强调色径向渐变圆 + 白星 + 两层带色软阴影，成为唯一主角；吞并时刻加一圈只发一次的细环涟漪（扩到 2.1 倍淡出）
擦除阶段（0.76→0.93，smooth 缓动）整幅画布左移 112 设计 px 把徽标收到正中；字幕居中于徽标下方、上浮淡入，逐词加深在 0.95 前完成，尾段留出落定
issuesEn: Flat light-grey background and uniform 1.2px pure-black lines, harsh and thin
Source nodes were white circles labeled S1–S4, like debug placeholders; their resting positions were misaligned (40-step scan) so they didn't form a column
Data packets were 7px hollow blue rings with no sense of speed, reading as noise
The badge was a white disc with a black star, same visual weight as the sources; absorption had only a scale bump
The final badge sat at 3/4 right, the caption was off-center and its word darkening ran to the last frame, so the end frame was unbalanced and never settled
changesEn: Soft-lit light backdrop (key light upper right, faint indigo spill, vignette, grain); curves are 0.9px round-cap strokes with a light-grey-to-ink gradient that reads as flow direction

Nodes are top-lit porcelain discs (gradient, hairline, inner highlight, size-dependent two-layer shadow) with grey line icons (database/cloud/sheet/API), popping in with ~8% overshoot; f0 is calibrated exactly as 96/len so the four nodes align
Packets are solid accent-gradient dots with a 9-sample comet tail sampled backwards along the path; cycle and phase offsets unchanged
Badge is an accent radial-gradient disc with a white star and tinted two-layer shadow, the sole hero; one thin ripple ring expands to 2.1x at absorption
During the erase (0.76→0.93, smooth ease) the canvas pans 112 design px left to center the badge; caption is centered below it, rises in, and finishes darkening by 0.95 so the tail settles
